name: story-studio-kh
description: Story Studio KH — continuity-first video pipeline for YouTube channels. Research, scripts, voice, narration-timed scenes, optional motion, and assembly across scenes, listicle, and character-locked formats.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n front,ts,electron -c cyan,yellow,magenta "cd frontend && npx nuxt dev --port 3000" "cd electron && npx tsc --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 electron/dist/main.js && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run check:changelog && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run check:changelog && npm run fetch:ffmpeg && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.test:backend: cd electron && STORY_STUDIO_DISABLE_LISTEN=1 npx tsx --test --test-force-exit server/__tests__/*.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:electron && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
